# Storage limits

### Public Storage add-on

| Storage add-on | Price      | Per TB       |
| -------------- | ---------- | ------------ |
| 1 TB           | $12/month  | $12/TB/month |
| 5 TB           | $60/month  | $12/TB/month |
| 50 TB          | $500/month | $10/TB/month |

### Private storage Pay-as-you-go

Additional storage is charged above the included amount at a base price of $18/TB/mo.

| Volume | Price (private repos) |
| ------ | --------------------- |
| Base   | $18/TB/mo             |
| 50TB+  | $16/TB/mo             |
| 200TB+ | $14/TB/mo             |
| 500TB+ | $12/TB/mo             |
